name: @hyphae-to/hyp
description: Cross-harness coordination, event streams, and chat bridges for AI coding agents.

scripts.site: node -e 'import("node:http").then(({createServer})=>import("node:fs").then(({readFileSync})=>{const t={".html":"text/html",".css":"text/css",".js":"text/javascript",".jpg":"image/jpeg",".jpeg":"image/jpeg",".png":"image/png",".svg":"image/svg+xml",".webp":"image/webp",".sh":"text/plain"};createServer((q,s)=>{const u=(q.url||"/").split("?")[0];const f="site"+(u==="/"?"/index.html":u);try{const b=readFileSync(f);const ext=f.slice(f.lastIndexOf("."));s.writeHead(200,{"content-type":t[ext]||"application/octet-stream"});s.end(b)}catch{s.writeHead(404).end("Not found")}}).listen(4173,"127.0.0.1",()=>console.log("Presentation site running at http://127.0.0.1:4173"))}))'
